description: Replaces a parameterized query with an f-string that interpolates untrusted username input directly into SQL.

findings.summary: SQL injection via f-string interpolation of the username parameter
findings.evidence: The parameterized query 'WHERE username = ?' with a bound (username,) tuple was replaced by an f-string that splices username directly into the SQL text, e.g. username="' OR '1'='1" alters the query.
